summary_1line: Brahma explains to Rudra the nature of the single supreme Purusha—Narayana—an all-pervading, attribute-transcending inner soul underlying all beings.

image_candidates.scene_text: Brahma and Rudra stand upon the lonely peak of Mount Vaijayanta as Brahma speaks of the unseen Purusha who pervades the entire universe.
A cosmic figure whose head, arms, eyes, and feet are formed from the galaxies and the universe itself, symbolizing the all-pervading Purusha.
A radiant inner light seated within countless human and animal bodies, silently witnessing their actions from within.
